body.condition: \[ \sup_{a,j,\ell}\|1-I_aq^0_{a\ell}\|_4\le M_{q,n},\quad \sup_{a,j,\ell}\|I_a(Y-h^0_{aj})\|_4\le M_{y,n},\quad \max_{c\le J_n}\|D^0_{J_n,c}\|_2\le B_{D,n},\quad \|B^0\|_2\le B_{0,n}; \] conditional exponential-moment bounds are imposed by \(\mathrm{ass:empirical-moment-perturbation}\).

novel.justification: These explicit multiplier and population calibration envelopes are the primitive bounds used by the nested projection argument; they are not attributed to the mixed-bias references.
